description.value: Gather is a family-run Mediterranean restaurant in Daajing Giids on South Haida Gwaii, blending Italian and Lebanese influences — Roman-style sheet pan pizzas, housemade falafel, pasta, and fresh local seafood. The project grew out of monthly community dinners held after the owners relocated to the island in 2019, and the communal long-table spirit still defines the place. It is one of very few sit-down dinner restaurants in this remote community, making it a notable stop for cyclists touring Haida Gwaii.
